pets.rules: Up to 2 dogs, not on beds or in the pool; Rs 2,000 cleaning fee per stay

bonfire.alternative: Outdoor lantern dinner setup on the lawn, Rs 4,000

spa_in_villa.price: From Rs 3,000 per 60 min, via partner

yacht_or_boat.price: Sunset cruise on the Mandovi from Rs 18,000 for up to 8

house_rules: No outside events or parties above registered guest count
Valid ID for every adult at check-in

villas.name: Casa Alba
villas.early_check_in: On request from 12:00, subject to availability
villas.directions: From Mandwa jetty, 20 min drive towards Awas. Pass Awas beach road, turn right at the Ganpati temple; Casa Alba is the third gate. Speedboat or ferry from Gateway of India to Mandwa.
villas.power_backup: Inverter for lights and fans only; no AC on backup

pool.type: Private pool with a kids' section

private_chef.price: Rs 3,000 per day plus groceries at actuals

airport_transfer.alternative: Mandwa jetty pick-up and drop, Rs 1,200 one way

spa_in_villa.alternative: Partner spa in Alibaug town, 25 min away

house_rules: Valid ID for every adult at check-in

villas.name: Ridge House
villas.early_check_in: Not possible on weekends; on request on weekdays
villas.directions: From the Mumbai-Pune Expressway, exit at Lonavala, follow signs to Tiger Point. 2 km before Tiger Point, take the gated lane on the right marked 'Ridge House'. Last 300 m is a steep paved road.
villas.wifi: Airfibre, 60 Mbps; patchy in heavy monsoon

pets.rules: Up to 2 pets; Rs 2,500 cleaning fee per stay

private_chef.price: Included for groups of 10 or more; else Rs 3,500 per day plus groceries

airport_transfer.price: Rs 4,500 one way from Pune airport, Rs 6,500 from Mumbai

bonfire.price: Rs 1,500 per evening (not in monsoon, June to September)

trek_guide.price: Rs 2,500 for a group, Rajmachi or Duke's Nose

house_rules: Valid ID for every adult at check-in
